entities.summary: Lesley Rosemary Turner Bowrey, AM is a retired professional tennis player from Australia. Her career spanned two decades from the late 1950s until the late 1970s. Turner Bowrey won the singles title at the French Championships, one of the four Grand Slam events, in 1963 and 1965. In addition she won 11 Grand Slam events in doubles and mixed doubles. Turner Bowrey achieved her highest singles ranking of No. 2 in 1964. Lesley Turner Bowrey was a athletes & competitors from Trangie (b. 1942-08-16, Trangie). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
